question: The ______ volume of the ‘Akbar Nama’ is known as Ain-i-Akbari.
solution:
The correct answer is__** third**__.

__
 
• **The third volume of the 'Akbar Nama' is known as Ain-i-Akbari**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abul Fazl wrote a three-volume history of Akbar's reign**, titled Akbar Nama.
 
• The **first volume dealt with Akbar's forefathers**, while the **second volume described Akbar's reign**. **The Ain-i Akbari is the third volume**.
 
• It deals with **Akbar's administration, household, army, revenues, and the geography** of his empire. 
 
• It also contains a wealth of information about the Indian people's customs and culture.
 
• The Ain-i Akbari's most intriguing feature is its wealth of statistical information on crops, yields, prices, wages, and income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png]
